scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up postgres -d && concurrently --names 'server,client' --prefix-colors 'yellow,cyan' 'npm --prefix server run dev' 'cd client && /usr/local/opt/node@20/bin/node ./node_modules/.bin/vite'
scripts.stop: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop postgres
